verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's Vault entity explicitly stores and references secrets so they're never visible in plaintext, and supports multiple backends including environment variables, Konnect Config Store, and third-party vault backends (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager style integrations), directly matching the masked-secrets/external-vault story for platform engineers. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of vault backend setup and no explicit mention of a broad list of supported third-party vault providers.
